The '''mother''' of [[Bertroff Hissa]], a [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], was a [[Sephi/Legends|Sephi]] woman. She and [[Bertroff Hissa's father|her husband]] were former [[Politics/Legends|political]] agitators who had chosen to settle on [[PL-40112-CE-021105]], a barren [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], to lead a "simpler" and "more natural" life. She was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during a conflict that opposed the inhabitants of PL-40112-CE-021105 and the Imperials against the [[Rozzum]].<ref name="BT1" />
